semiconductor_relevance: High — DS Fibertech Corporation specializes in the design and manufacture of diffusion furnace cassettes and related components critical for wafer fabrication in the semiconductor industry.
summary: DS Fibertech Corporation is a leading manufacturer of diffusion furnace cassettes and electric heating elements used in semiconductor wafer fabrication. They provide a range of products including direct replacement elements for major OEM furnace tools and refurbishment services, catering to the needs of global wafer manufacturing facilities.
capabilities: Diffusion furnace cassettes for wafer fabrication
High temperature annealing chambers up to 1750C
Direct replacement elements for OEM furnace tools

regional_presence.North America: Supports approximately 100 manufacturing facilities and OEMs across the region.
regional_presence.Asia: Engages with numerous semiconductor foundries and manufacturers.
regional_presence.Europe: Provides services and products to various semiconductor manufacturers.
